# Wyndly

> Wyndly is a telemedicine platform offering FDA-approved sublingual immunotherapy as an alternative to traditional allergy shots, combined with at-home allergy testing and personalized treatment plans.

Wyndly provides comprehensive allergy management through board-certified allergists and otolaryngologists. The platform combines convenient at-home allergy testing, online physician consultations, and prescription sublingual immunotherapy drops to help patients achieve long-term allergy relief.

## Key Topics

- Sublingual immunotherapy
- At-home allergy testing
- Telemedicine/Telehealth
- FDA-approved treatment
- Personalized treatment plans
- Seasonal allergies
- Pet allergies
- Indoor allergies
- Allergy immunotherapy
- Money-back guarantee
- FSA/HSA eligible
- Board-certified physicians
- Allergy relief
- Online consultation

## Core Products & Services

- [Sublingual Allergy Immunotherapy Drops & Tablets](https://www.wyndly.com/pages/immunotherapy): Wyndly's FDA-approved sublingual immunotherapy product: at-home drops for long-term allergy relief
- [At-Home Allergy Test Kit](https://www.wyndly.com/products/at-home-allergy-test): Comprehensive at-home allergy testing kit for indoor and outdoor allergens
- [Insurance-Covered At-Home Allergy Test](https://www.wyndly.com/products/at-home-allergy-test-indoor-outdoor-insurance): At-home allergy test with insurance coverage and FSA/HSA eligibility
- [Online Allergy Doctor Consultation](https://www.wyndly.com/products/allergy-doctor-consult-online): Telemedicine consultation with board-certified allergists for prescription and personalized treatment
